description: Aider-polyglot style (Python): implement a football league table from a stub and an instructions file - fixed-width layout, head-to-head tiebreak applied once per points group, then goal difference, goals scored and name, plus ValueError with the 1-based line number for malformed lines. The unit tests are the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs them, so a failing first attempt gets a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
